summary: A bigger opportunity can make an old insecurity much louder because there is suddenly more to lose.
body: A bigger opportunity can make an old insecurity much louder because there is suddenly more to lose. When Jupiter conjuncts Chiron, growth can enlarge both the possibility and the sensitivity attached to it, so a promotion, course, audience, trip, teaching role, or generous offer may bring up doubt you thought you had already outgrown. The return of the doubt does not mean you have gone backward or that the opportunity is wrong. Check the terms, support, and practical demands, then judge the opportunity by what it requires now rather than by what a smaller version once made you believe about yourself.
